_comment: Short (few-words) blurbs for each CORE bonus, shown on its card in the on-page list (vs the full 'effect' text in core_bonuses.json, which only appears in the detail modal). Loaded by index.html as L.core_terse. Same safe-fallback pattern as core_bonus_stat_mods.json — missing file or missing id just means no blurb is shown, nothing breaks. Keyed by CORE bonus id, each value has 'en' and 'ru'.

cb_improved_armament.en: Extra Flex mount if you have fewer than 3
cb_improved_armament.ru: Доп. Гибкое крепление, если меньше 3 креплений

cb_mount_retrofitting.en: One mount becomes a Main/Aux mount

cb_universal_compatibility.en: Free full repair when you use a CORE Power

cb_briareos_frame.en: Resistance to all damage, survive 0 HP
cb_briareos_frame.ru: Resistance ко всему урону, живучесть на 0 ОЗ

cb_fomorian_frame.en: +1 Size step, up to a max of 3

cb_sloped_plating.en: +1 Armor, up to a max of 4

cb_all_theater_movement_suite.en: Fly freely, +1 Heat per turn you do
cb_all_theater_movement_suite.ru: Свободный полёт, +1 Тепло за ход в полёте

cb_ghostweave.en: Invisible on your turn if you stay passive
cb_ghostweave.ru: Невидимость на своём ходу при пассивности

cb_the_lesson_of_the_open_door.en: +2 Save Target, 2 heat on a failed save

cb_the_lesson_of_the_held_image.en: Free reactive Lock On each ally's turn
cb_the_lesson_of_the_held_image.ru: Бесплатный Lock On на ходу союзника

cb_the_lesson_of_thinking_tomorrows_thou.en: Tech hit boosts your next melee attack

cb_the_lesson_of_transubstantiation.en: Vanish and return when you take structure damage
cb_the_lesson_of_transubstantiation.ru: Исчезаете и возвращаетесь при уроне по Структуре

cb_the_lesson_of_shaping.ru: Второй ИИ как страховка от cascade

cb_armory_sculpted_chassis.en: +1 Accuracy on Engineering, cover on Overcharge

cb_stasis_shielding.en: Resistance to all damage after stress damage
cb_stasis_shielding.ru: Resistance ко всему урону после урона по стрессу
